output.narrative: The click-through rate (ctr) decreased by 0.000579 (from 0.010953 to 0.010374), driven primarily by a drop in fill_rate which contributed -22.97 to the revenue delta. Across checked dimensions, the movement was heavily concentrated in country=IN, which had an explanatory power of 0.262 and a lift of 4.47. In contrast, segments like ad_format=banner were ruled out with an explanatory power of 0.003 and a lift of 0.01. Drilling deeper into country=IN, the drop was further concentrated within device_model=Pixel 8, which recorded an explanatory power of 0.157 and a striking lift of 6.2.
